name: Blake Moore
bio: a Representative from Utah; born in Ogden, Weber County, Utah, June 22, 1980; graduated from Ogden High School, Ogden, Utah, 1998; attended Utah State University, Logan, Utah; B.A., University of Utah, Salt Lake City, Utah; M.P.P.A., Northwestern University, Evanston, Ill., 2018; consultant; foreign service officer, United States Department of State; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
